gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Loud, loose and wide-striding up top. Revalia's open-tailed g and tall letter band lead, while Noto Sans Deseret settles underneath with squat ascenders and open curves that keep the text approachable.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Revalia swaggers with its widely spaced letters and a g whose lower curve hangs open, bold and expressive. Noto Sans Devanagari then runs compact and modern, a sans whose capitals melt into the lowercase, so a long passage moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Bold, with a relaxed stride. Revalia is built for making a loud statement in few words, whereas Noto Sans Duployan, a sans with a wide-mouthed a and generous counters, is made for steady text.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Revalia stretches its widely separated letters along the line, with a tall band and short stalks above it. And Noto Sans Elbasan, a plain sans with large lowercase and terminals that never pinch shut, keeps a long passage moving without any strain.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: That open-tailed lowercase g gives Revalia its swagger, with tall letters spread across a relaxed stride. And Noto Sans Elymaic, a plain sans with open apertures throughout, makes the pair feel like a loud voice handing off to a clear one.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Noto Sans Ethiopic stands tall and sturdy, its c terminals hanging well away from the bowl. Revalia is the one to hand the big, bold, expressive moments, while Noto Sans Ethiopic handles the steady, modern sans-serif text beneath.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Noto Sans Georgian reads modern and clean, with open curves and short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies. Add Revalia's bold swagger, and the pairing has real range.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Revalia is bold and expressive, with an open-tailed g and widely separated letters that earn their keep set big and short. Noto Sans Glagolitic, a plain sans with open round letters and a tall, sturdy body, takes over from there.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Noto Sans Gothic opens with counters like drilled glass beads. Revalia sits above with a bold, expressive stride and widely separated letters, and the two sit comfortably together on the page.
